in_hindi.name: दानवीर
in_hindi.long_meaning: दाना (Daana) - दान (to give) + वीर (Veer) - वीर्य (courage, bravery)

in_marathi.name: Danveer
in_marathi.long_meaning: Danveer हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Danveer is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘danu’ (gift) and ‘veer’ (brave). It is a name that signifies the spirit of bravery and the bestowal of gifts. In Hindu mythology, Danveer is the name of a brave and just king.
